articles.title: A Tiny Red Plant With a Death Hug
articles.summary: Newly named as its own species, the Florida threadleaf sundew lives in one tiny Panhandle patch scientists are racing to protect.

articles.title: A Forgotten Particle May Explain Why the Universe Exists
articles.summary: A long-dismissed heavy neutrino may have tipped the early universe in favor of matter, scientists propose.

articles.title: A Tiny Motor Inspired by an Ancient Screw
articles.summary: A molecule-sized Archimedes screw spins on electricity, reverses on command, and conducts far better while turning.
